That is persistence work, so it belongs to the infrastructure layer kind, not domain. The file holds no domain logic or rules. Its path (`infrastructure/persistence/relational/entities`) and its consumers (repository, mapper, persistence module) confirm it is a persistence model. The likely cause is a wrong layer assignment from the filename pattern rather than a misplaced responsibility. Judged against the declared domain layer, though, it carries persistence/framework responsibility, which the rubric names as a failure.
